# Does a heat pump beat a new gas furnace on your prices?

> Free heat pump vs gas furnace calculator for homeowners. Enter your gas therms, prices, COP and quotes to see running cost per million BTU, the break-even COP, payback against a new furnace and AC, and lifetime saving. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
